fields.field: Clinical phenotypes reported in affected individuals with ACBD6-related neurodevelopmental disorder (OMIM #620785)
Phenotype frequency given as numerator and denominator per assessed cohort (not percentage alone)
Phenotype descriptions as worded in the original paper plus standard HPO term where identifiable
Resolvable source citation (PMID or DOI) and cohort identification attached to each reported phenotype frequency
Most discriminating clinical findings (present in most affected individuals but uncommon in disorders usually confused with it)
Specific disorders commonly confused with this condition
Confidence level for each distinguishing clinical feature/differential
Phenotypes assessed and confirmed absent in affected individuals (features arguing against the diagnosis if present)
Phenotypic differences or correlations by variant type, variant position, patient age, or patient sex
Phenotypic findings reported by one paper and explicitly contradicted by another
